# Finch Logistics

Mid-size third-party logistics (3PL) company. Runs 3 warehouses, all in the southern region. Our
first real paying customer — took a chance on Northstar back when we were basically pre-revenue,
which Sara reminds everyone of constantly.

Currently running our pallet movers + routing engine across all 3 sites, about 40 robots total
(roughly split 15/15/10 across the sites, biggest site has the most floor space). Contract is up for
renewal soon — see the renewal deal doc for terms being discussed.

Point of contact on their side is their ops director (name escapes whoever wrote this doc
originally, sorry — check the CRM). Sara Kim owns the relationship on our side.
